# hostwarden Provider

Manage standalone ESXi hosts and their virtual machines through a Hostwarden server. Authenticate with a token, or with a user name and password. Changes require an administrator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hostwarden = { source = "fdaforno/hostwarden" }
  }
}

# Credentials can also come from the environment:
# HOSTWARDEN_ADDRESS, HOSTWARDEN_USERNAME and HOSTWARDEN_PASSWORD, or HOSTWARDEN_TOKEN.
provider "hostwarden" {
  address  = "http://hostwarden.example.lan:8080"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.hostwarden_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Base URL of the Hostwarden server (e.g. http://hostwarden:8080). Env: HOSTWARDEN_ADDRESS.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of username. Env: HOSTWARDEN_PASSWORD.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API bearer token, from POST /api/v1/auth/login. A token expires after 7 days without use. Env: HOSTWARDEN_TOKEN.
- `username` (String) User name, as an alternative to token: the provider opens the session itself. Env: HOSTWARDEN_USERNAME.
